Container.Name: sniparr
Container.Overview: Sniparr — Automated missing-media hunter and stuck-download manager for your *arr stack (Sonarr, Radarr, Lidarr, Readarr, Whisparr). Includes Swaparr for stuck download removal, quality-upgrade hunting, and a hardened security layer with CSRF protection, signed sessions, and SSRF-guarded instance URLs. Ground-up project by MrJacobarussell.
Container.Category: MediaApp: Video MediaApp: Music MediaApp: Books Tools:

Config.Name: Config Storage
Config.Description: Persistent storage for Sniparr settings, database, and logs.

Config.Name: Localtime
Config.Description: Inherit timezone from the Unraid host. Set your timezone in Unraid Settings → Date and Time.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID the container process runs as. Unraid default is 99.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID the container process runs as. Unraid default is 100.

Config.Name: TZ
Config.Description: Timezone string (e.g. America/New_York, Europe/London). Used for log timestamps and scheduled search windows.

Config.Name: Auth Mode
Config.Description: Leave blank for built-in login. Set to 'proxy' to delegate authentication to a reverse proxy (Authelia, Authentik, oauth2-proxy). In proxy mode direct access without the proxy header returns 403.

Config.Name: Proxy Auth Header
Config.Description: Header your reverse proxy injects with the authenticated username. Only used when Auth Mode is set to 'proxy'. Default: Remote-User.

Config.Name: Trusted Proxies
Config.Description: Comma-separated list of reverse-proxy IPs that are allowed to supply the auth header (e.g. 172.16.0.1,192.168.1.1). X-Forwarded-For is only honoured from these IPs. Required when Auth Mode is proxy.
